f_01KXADA2TSEMSC1FXYK8AZ5Z51.subject: addition_footprint
f_01KXADA2TSEMSC1FXYK8AZ5Z51.content: The addition is a two-story structure with a 30' × 10' (300 sqft per floor) footprint.

f_01KXADA2TT57PS3F5ED5NXBMM9.subject: addition_program
f_01KXADA2TT57PS3F5ED5NXBMM9.content: Addition provides basement-level storage at grade and, on the second floor, a primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXADA2TTG2RKQ9S6RSMZJ409.subject: foundation_spec
f_01KXADA2TTG2RKQ9S6RSMZJ409.content: Foundation uses continuous 12"×12" concrete footings with 4" gravel base, vapor barrier, reinforcement, and 4" concrete slab; no CMU or full-height foundation wall is anticipated.

f_01KXADA2TT1622HAZ8VKED6YYH.subject: lvl_beam_spec
f_01KXADA2TT1622HAZ8VKED6YYH.content: One 3-ply 14" LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" is required to open a load-bearing wall.

f_01KXADA2TTKJ9VFY201TJ59AAY.subject: elevator_shaft_scope
f_01KXADA2TTKJ9VFY201TJ59AAY.content: A 4'×4' future elevator shaft is framed within scope; the elevator unit is explicitly excluded.

f_01KXADA2TTE1S1EPT4ZM8D6830.subject: roof_configuration
f_01KXADA2TTE1S1EPT4ZM8D6830.content: New 3/12 gable roof ties into the existing 6/12 roof with architectural asphalt shingles to match; fascia board, vinyl soffit, and seamless gutters are included.

f_01KXADA2TT0J3DWPDCF8NYVPBK.subject: window_spec
f_01KXADA2TT0J3DWPDCF8NYVPBK.content: Four windows are specified: three 36"×60" units and one transom; exact match to existing is not guaranteed.

f_01KXADA2TTW1JSVZNXT1A6DCGR.subject: electrical_subpanel_scope
f_01KXADA2TTW1JSVZNXT1A6DCGR.content: A new 100A subpanel is in electrical scope; the scope document states it assumes existing main service capacity is sufficient without an upgrade.

f_01KXADA2TVVFX873ZTE70D3H0H.subject: tdec_septic_pre_construction
f_01KXADA2TVVFX873ZTE70D3H0H.content: Pre-construction scope explicitly requires a TDEC septic capacity inspection and determination of relocation or grinder pump feasibility; actual septic/grinder costs are excluded as a change order item.

f_01KXADA2TV0N5S997H7SHPRXW1.subject: change_order_exclusions
f_01KXADA2TV0N5S997H7SHPRXW1.content: Explicit change order exclusions include rock excavation, unsuitable soils, concealed conditions, septic relocation/replacement/grinder system, and structural modifications beyond standard tie-in.

f_01KXADA2TVJQ4TARJZWVB00Q51.subject: site_work_heat_pump
f_01KXADA2TVJQ4TARJZWVB00Q51.content: Site work includes relocating the existing heat pump and its electrical disconnect.

f_01KXADA2TVJ7KRJSZ0M00WVMQ5.subject: gas_vent_extension
f_01KXADA2TVJ7KRJSZ0M00WVMQ5.content: Scope includes extending the existing gas water heater vent through the new roof as part of roofing work.

f_01KXADA2TVDCAWA3HCZJJTRXBN.subject: job_status
f_01KXADA2TVDCAWA3HCZJJTRXBN.content: Job status is 'waiting_work' with medium priority.

f_01KXADA2TV3HY0C7W1ZFTNJFNY.subject: scheduled_start_date
f_01KXADA2TV3HY0C7W1ZFTNJFNY.content: Job is scheduled to start on 2026-10-05.
